User: My name is Karen
Agent: Karen — thanks. Is the boiler showing an error code, or blank?

User: Yes, that's correct
Agent: I’m checking the nearest slots now.
Agent: Karen — I’ve got today at 6pm, or tomorrow at 2pm. Which suits?
User: Tomorrow works
Agent: Tomorrow works — thanks. Just a second.Right, Karen, I’ve got you at 5 Elm St — postcode N-E-6, 6-F-F — tomorrow at 2pm. Sound okay?
User: Yes, book it
Agent: Brilliant, I’m booking that in now.
Agent: You’re booked in, Karen. Is there anything else I can help you with?
User: That's all, thanks
